scoring_justification: Cannot recompute ZT from the CSV because the underlying transport model is not re-executable in the checker; compare agent's computed ZT values at hidden concentration points to paper-derived reference values within tolerance, plus peak checks.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference ZT values at selected electron concentrations for n-type Bi2Te2.7Se0.3 at 500 K, and peak thresholds/concentrations, derived from the paper's Fig. 2 and Section III A.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Physical Review B 93, 165209 (2016), Fig. 2 and the discussion of maximum ZT values (max. bulk ZT ~1.0 at 3e19 cm-3, barrier ZT ~1.7 at 1e19 cm-3).
hidden_assets.generation_method: The maximum values are taken directly from the paper's text. Approximate curve values at intermediate concentrations were estimated consistently with the described shape and the bipolar suppression effect.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are anchored to the paper's reported maximum ZT and the qualitative curve behaviour; approximate reference values at intermediate points are physically consistent with the model. The tolerance (15%) is chosen to absorb implementation differences.

outputs.description: CSV table of zT values as a function of electron concentration for n-type Bi2Te2.7Se0.3 at 500 K, for both bulk and barrier cases. The hidden checker compares these values against reference values derived from the paper's computations with tolerance for numerical differences.

output_contract.notes: Checker will compare the reported zT values at a set of electron concentration points against hidden reference values. Additional check on peak zT meeting or exceeding the paper-reported level is included.
